## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Requester meaning: independently choose a random complex concept that tests the electricity, lightning, discharge and electrical-device topic from the preceding conversation, and use the supplied image. The face and hair are the reference scope, with original clothes and framing left open. Independent agent selection (seed 1574489756) chose a fictional last-keeper departure ceremony in a lighthouse storm archive. I compared a keeper farewell, an oath cabinet and a departure annunciator before catalog access. The keeper version gives physical equipment, archived traces and a just-lit lamp a connected reason to share the frame; its quieter resolve better supports the reference presence than a generic commanding lightning pose. All plot, role, props, wardrobe and exact electrical forms are agent-owned. WHO: she completes the last activation before leaving. WHERE: a packing archive gives the action consequence. HOW: a nearby observer reads her face and the tabletop circuit together. WHY NOW: the lamp has just illuminated while the lever remains depressed. Sensual 1 supports through collarbone light, fit, parted lips and unguarded concentration, without added fetish emphasis. Creativity 1 remains close to electrical phenomena while honoring the explicit random complex-concept request. Surreal 0 keeps fictional equipment materially staged at ordinary scale with ordinary electrical effects. The viewer should feel a quiet farewell grounded in a visible operation, while spark endpoints, diffuse point corona and cable-to-lamp continuity form distinct tests.
subject: A woman based on the supplied portrait, using its face and hair as the reference scope.

visual_priorities: The keeper face, still-depressed insulating lever and newly glowing lamp form a readable causal moment.
A thin bridging gap spark and separate local point-corona brushes are visually distinguishable on the apparatus.
Cables visibly join the physical apparatus to the lamp, while packing traces connect its operation to departure.
Reference face and short black bob remain recognizable within the person-centered photographic scene.
baseline_prompt_en: A cinematic photographic scene centered on electrical phenomena, staged as the last working evening in an old lighthouse archive. A woman based on the supplied portrait is the keeper at the bench; use the supplied portrait for her face and hair, retaining its soft oval face, wide dark eyes, soft rosy lips, short black bob and fine separated bangs. The room is being packed for departure: tied archive boxes occupy the shelves, empty circular dust marks show where recording reels stood, and her closed travel bag waits against her hip. Her charcoal wool dress has a simple square neckline, a softly fitted waist and small creases from bending over the bench; warm light grazes her collarbones and her unguarded, concentrated face. She has just pushed the apparatus's long black ebonite lever downward with her right hand, her fingers wrapped around its full insulated grip and her bent elbow beside her ribs. Her left hand lightly holds the travel bag strap at her hip. Both feet support her behind the waist-high bench, with her torso leaning only slightly toward the reachable lever. The invention is a brass and glazed-ceramic discharge annunciator assembled as a real piece of equipment. There is visible electrical discharge at metal electrodes: on the raised brass deck a single thin, jagged white-violet spark bridges the clearly separated tips of two rounded copper terminals. Farther to the right, on a separate pointed charging comb, tiny diffuse violet corona brushes cling close to the sharp metal points. The bright gap flash and the faint local corona remain distinct in scale and texture. Red and black braided cables visibly terminate at the apparatus base and its cylindrical coil enclosure; a paired insulated lead continues from that enclosure to a small beacon lamp beneath thick glass at the left end of the bench. The amber lamp has just come alive, its reflected oval appearing on the worn wood while she looks toward it with parted lips and a restrained exhale. The lever, cable route, illuminated lamp and packed room connect the final activation to her impending departure. Photograph from slightly to the left of the apparatus at chest height in a vertical knee-up environmental portrait: her face, gripping hand, gap terminals, corona comb and lamp occupy one readable layer. A 50 mm lens at moderate depth of field keeps these connections legible; the archive shelves recede gently. Dusk enters the high salt-streaked window, the amber lamp warms her skin, and violet discharge casts small local reflections on glazed ceramic. Natural skin texture, scuffed brass, ceramic glaze and faint low-light grain give the invention physical weight.
